target: Diagnose supported termination, not establish a new recovery mechanism

prospective_design.full_recovery: Freeze and disclose both service budgets and experiment horizon before execution; observe complete terminal path or explicit censoring
prospective_design.single_decision: State horizon=1 explicitly; score immediate decision separately from eventual recovery
controls: publicly unidentifiable state with lawful escalation
information_conditions: raw evidence plus shared numeric helper
prospective_design.parity: Within each information condition the model and strong public rule receive identical fields, permissions, helper computation and budget caps; actual costs reported separately
prospective_design.factual_probe: Separate arm; never prepend a diagnosis question and treat downstream behavior as unprompted
prospective_design.ground_truth: Private ledger and reference labels only at grading; source content and numeric helper do not certify historical safety
prospective_design.independence: Split by source and template ancestry; old Occupancy variants remain development only
prospective_design.sample_size: Not fixed or justified yet; no independent test panel admitted
prospective_design.model: DeepSeek continuity proposed, no model request approved
prospective_design.learning: No RL or SFT authorized by this draft

admission_requirements: Independent review of interface, actual source lineage and concrete scientific increment
Pre-outcome eligibility and frozen common denominator
Threshold, uncertainty method, sample-size rationale and cost budget
Explicit authorization for any new provider run
stop_conditions: Old interface or arithmetic explains observed difference
Only generic known model decision errors remain
Unequal information or helper cost creates advantage
No nontrivial increment beyond existing benchmarks
